meta.name: avoid-ai-writing
meta.description: Audit and rewrite prose so it stops reading as machine-generated. Use this skill when asked to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, edit a draft for AI tells, audit a README, changelog, release note, PR description, or blog post for machine-sounding prose, or make text sound less like AI. Supports a detect-only mode, a rewrite mode, and an edit-in-place mode, with optional voice and context profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让文稿读起来像真人写作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要让机器写的文案更像真人手笔
copy.tagline_en: Make any text read less like AI and more like you.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to remove AI-sounding phrasing from drafts and posts.

howto.what: Claude 会找出文稿里像机器生成的写作模式,并改写掉它们。默认模式下它逐条引用有问题的原句,交回干净的改写稿并说明改了什么;也可以只标记不修改,或直接在文件里做最小改动。
howto.when: 当你要求去掉 AI 腔、清理 AI 写作,或让它审阅 README、更新日志、PR 描述等文稿是否有机器味时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇草稿里的 AI 味改掉

say.text: 只检测不修改,告诉我哪些是明确的 AI 痕迹
say.note: detect 模式:按严重度分组列出问题

say.text: 直接把这个 README 文件里的 AI 腔改掉

howto.what_en: Claude finds patterns that make prose read as machine-generated and rewrites them. By default it quotes each flagged span, returns a clean version, and summarizes changes; it can also flag only, or edit a file in place.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, or audit a README, changelog, release note, PR description, or blog post for machine-sounding prose.

say_en.text: Rewrite this draft so it stops sounding like AI.
say_en.note: Default rewrite mode: flags plus a clean version

say_en.text: Just flag the AI patterns, don't rewrite anything.
say_en.note: Detect mode: issues grouped by severity

say_en.text: Clean up the AI-isms in this README file in place.
say_en.note: Edit mode: minimal targeted edits to the file
